name: Helminth

facts.text: Helminth: level 36, the troglodyte body (model 113) at size 102, nearly three times a troglodyte's (38), at about 28,900/34,700 (z 12,573) on the lowest level among troglodytes (37-45) and lair worms; respawn 180 seconds; a plain spawn.
Helminth is from Greek helmins, a worm; in English it means a parasitic worm.

story:
The ursine call him Helminth, which Hervelina says is a scholar's word for a worm, and they named him for what they hear. Under the king's hall something bores through the rock day and night, and the ursine have never gone down to see what. A worm, they decided, the size of a boat. The lair worms bore through everything else in the caves, so it was not a strange thing to decide.

Those who have gone down to the lowest level and come back say it is no worm. It is a troglodyte, one of the oldest people of the rock, who kept the deep galleries before the ursine came and keep them still in numbers the ursine do not like to count, and Helminth is the greatest of them, grown nearly three times their size. He does not bore. He digs, with his hands, and the troglodytes keep about him like a household round its eldest.

What he is digging toward is the troglodytes' own business. Hervelina thinks it is the caves' first floor, the one the stone carried the old tribe up from, and that the troglodytes want it back. The druids think it is simply under the king, and that the troglodytes, who were here before anyone named a king, mean to remind the hall of that. The ursine do not think about it at all. They hear the worm, and they bank the fires a little higher.
legend: Helminth (36) is a huge troglodyte (the troglodyte body at nearly three times its size) on the lowest level of Treibh Caillte (about 28.9k/34.7k, z 12,570), with troglodytes (37-45) and lair worms round him. The troglodytes are higher level than he is: clear them carefully. Hursk the Alchemist (43) is about 1,700 away. A group of 40ish. Plain spawn, no script, 3-minute respawn.
